reference_source.identity_limitation: The original training candidate manifest did not cryptographically record the source commit or source-file hash; this is an audited reconstruction reference, not proof of the exact training checkout.

target.name: fuel_consumption_kg_s
target.inverse_scaling: Apply the training-fitted vqr_target_scaler.pkl MinMaxScaler inverse_transform to the simulator expectation reshaped as (n, 1); its fitted feature range is [-1, 1].

circuit.feature_map: One RY rotation on each qubit: x[0] through x[5] follow raw_features order.
circuit.ansatz: Qiskit real_amplitudes with theta[0] through theta[11], one repetition and a final rotation layer.
circuit.observable: Mean of the six single-qubit Z observables, each with coefficient 1/6; Qiskit Pauli labels use the rightmost character for qubit 0.

dependency_versions.python_provenance: Observed in the existing SIH export environment; not recorded by the original candidate manifest.

validation.limitation: These are validation metrics, not held-out test metrics or evidence of production readiness.

wind_direction_convention: Absolute versus relative and from versus toward are unverified.
environmental_snapshot_limitation: One supplied environmental snapshot would represent an entire calculation; this is not a time-series route forecast or measured voyage telemetry.
quick_candidate_exclusion: The quick candidate trained on 60 sampled rows for a simulator smoke test and is not packaged or selected as the application model.
packaging_note: Only inference files and selected metadata are packaged. The source candidate_manifest.json also hashes training-only files that remain in SIH and are intentionally absent here; use packaged_artifacts for this bundle's integrity checks.
